title: pnpm
description: Fast, disk-efficient package manager using a content-addressable store.

data.text: pnpm is a fast, disk-efficient package manager that stores packages in a content-addressable store on disk. When installing packages, it creates hard links instead of copying files, saving disk space and improving install speed.

terms.definition: A store where packages are identified by their content hash, enabling deduplication.
pnpm prevents packages from accessing undeclared dependencies, reducing bugs.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Saves disk space via hard links
data.takeaway: pnpm combines speed, disk efficiency, and strict dependency management.
